tools.name: search_vps_deals
tools.description: Search published VPS plan prices. Results are sorted from the lowest monthly USD price and include the article and provider links.

tools.name: compare_providers
tools.description: Compare two providers using the published plans in this dataset, including cheapest plan, locations, CN optimization, plan count, and article URLs.

tools.name: get_provider
tools.description: Find a provider by a case-insensitive fuzzy name match and return every published plan and article link for it.
